jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.content: <p>We run Kubernetes on AWS with Terraform and Argo CD. You will own CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, improve observability with Prometheus and Grafana, and join a light on-call rotation. Linux and Python scripting matter; Helm is a plus. Salary range €60,000 - €75,000 per year. Visa sponsorship available.</p>

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Same platform team, US requisition. Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform. Must be authorized to work in the United States; no visa sponsorship.</p>

jobs.title: Staff Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Lead multi-region Kubernetes platform design. 10+ years of experience running production infrastructure. Terraform, AWS, Argo CD, Prometheus.</p>
